assessment_type: AI-assisted rubric-based review; not independently human-verified

criteria.correctness: 1 if the answer factually addresses the question sufficiently; 0 if wrong, materially incomplete, nonresponsive, or answering another task.
criteria.hallucination: 1 if a material unsupported or contradictory factual claim is present; 0 if no such claim is identified.
criteria.visible_truncation: 1 only if the answer visibly ends incomplete; token-cap flag alone is not sufficient.

limitations: Provisional AI-assisted assessment; not independent human annotation.

A 20-example spot-check found at least one clear content-level question/reference-answer mismatch (sample-0088) and several multi-task prompts where the reference may cover only one component (including sample-0010 and sample-0020). These issues may make correctness and hallucination estimates unreliable.

The spot-check did not establish a general CSV row-order shift. The full 100 examples have not been manually verified; treat all AI-assisted response-quality counts as exploratory, not validated aggregate rates.
Official human-review labels remain blank; do not describe the estimates as human-verified.
The raw QA CSV includes examples from a gated dataset and is omitted from this shareable package.
